text:
[
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.1-1",
    "section": "2.1",
    "section_title": "Product Perspective",
    "text": "The system shall allow a patient to make a consultation request by entering symptoms.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.1-2",
    "section": "2.1",
    "section_title": "Product Perspective",
    "text": "The system shall forward the consultation request to a doctor of the concerned speciality.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.1-3",
    "section": "2.1",
    "section_title": "Product Perspective",
    "text": "The doctor shall generate a prescription comprising of Diagnosis, Medicines and Lab Requests (if needed) based on the symptoms provided by the patient.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.1-4",
    "section": "2.1",
    "section_title": "Product Perspective",
    "text": "The system shall send the prescription to the patient, the nearest local chemist, and the nearest local lab.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.1-5",
    "section": "2.1",
    "section_title": "Product Perspective",
    "text": "The system shall display only necessary information to Chemists and Labs to protect Patient confidentiality.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.1-6",
    "section": "2.1",
    "section_title": "Product Perspective",
    "text": "Labs shall update the lab report on the system for the patient to view anytime.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-1",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The Admin shall populate the speciality database based on various specialities present in the medical domain.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-2",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The Admin shall link the specialities to the doctors and populate the doctor database.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-3",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The Admin shall take information from labs and chemists to populate their databases.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-4",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The system shall allow a patient to register by filling his/her details.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-5",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The system shall allow a doctor to see a consultation request generated by a patient.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-6",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The system shall allow a doctor to give a diagnosis for a consultation request.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-7",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The system shall send the prescription generated by the doctor to the patient, chemist, and labs.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.2-8",
    "section": "2.2",
    "section_title": "Product Functions",
    "text": "The system shall allow Labs to update the lab report into the system for future reference for the patient.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  }
]
